egitim.title: Course Center Education System
egitim.levelsDesc: We provide quality education at every level from kindergarten to high school.
egitim.menuEtut: Tutoring and Office Question Solving Hours
egitim.introText: Kavram Course Centers Education System carries every student to success with strong communication and academic cooperation.
egitim.dataDrivenDesc: At Kavram Educational Institutions and Course Centers, students prepare for exams without exam anxiety through personalized developmental and career-oriented guidance.
egitim.academicTrackingDesc: Students' academic performance regarding the smallest learning unit is identified through detailed topic and competency analyses and addressed with a competency gap completion program.

egitim.publicationSectionTitle: High Academic Performance with Current Publication Packages
egitim.publicationSectionDesc: We support our students in exam preparation and success with Kavram Publications, combining publication experience since 1974 with current content and questions.
egitim.topicBooksDesc: Kavram Publications presents topics divided into explanation sheets to facilitate student learning.
egitim.questionBanksDesc: Academic performance evaluation by taking smart exams with specified topic/competency from publications on the digital platform.
egitim.testsDesc: Students become informed about their academic performance with worksheets without losing the excitement of instant learning.
egitim.staffDesc: Teachers at Kavram Course Centers possess the knowledge, experience and enthusiasm required by their profession.

egitim.questionOfficeDesc: Through question solving offices held weekly in the course library and tutoring rooms, our students develop question-solving practice by asking teachers questions they cannot solve.

kvkk.title: GDPR Disclosure Text
kvkk.mainTitle: Disclosure Text on Protection of Personal Data
kvkk.intro1: As Kavram Educational Institutions, we attach great importance to the security of your personal data within the scope of the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 ("GDPR").
kvkk.intro2: This disclosure text has been prepared for informational purposes regarding the processing of personal data of persons visiting our website and benefiting from our services.
kvkk.section1Desc: Kavram Educational Institutions processes your personal data as "Data Controller" within the scope of GDPR.
kvkk.section2Desc: Identity information (name, surname), contact information (phone, email, address), education information and website usage data are processed.
kvkk.section3Desc: Your personal data is processed for the purpose of providing education services, conducting registration procedures, carrying out communication activities and fulfilling legal obligations.
kvkk.section4Desc: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions and organizations within the framework of legal obligations.
kvkk.section5Desc: Within the scope of Article 11 of GDPR; you have the right to learn whether your personal data is processed, to request information if processed, and to learn the processing purpose and whether they are used in accordance with that purpose.
kvkk.section6Desc: You can submit your requests within the scope of GDPR to info@kavram.com.tr.
